responsibility: Implements structural hashing of RTL expressions for GCC’s incremental hash framework. Its inchash::add_rtx routine walks an rtx recursively, folding opcode, mode, immediates, vector contents, and selected operand fields into a hash state while treating special leaf nodes such as regs, constants, symbols, labels, and debug markers appropriately, so other RTL facilities can build stable hashes for canonicalization tables and memoized lookups.
same_name_distinction: Implements the recursive RTL structural hashing routine inchash::add_rtx declared in gcc/rtlhash.h, walking rtx codes, modes, immediates, vectors, and operands to feed a hash state; the header only exposes that hashing API.
